ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 82% high-intensity (white) to 18% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible ventral plane.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black) perimeter mapping (~15-40 pixels wide) bordering the entire fluke edge. Central lobes consist of high-intensity (white) pixels with sparse, discrete low-intensity focal clusters localized in the lower-medial quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression; calculated pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees with a significant bounding-box depth relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration profile along the trailing boundary; peak-to-valley amplitudes range from 5 to 22 pixels. Sharp, irregular indentations are concentrated on the upper-inner margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex bilateral sweep originating from the central notch, exhibiting a steepening positive slope towards the lateral terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-relief, high-intensity pixels (barnacles) visible at both distal lobe tips. Several small circular low-intensity clusters (rosette-like spots) are detected on the medial-right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (dark streaks) visible on the high-intensity background of the mid-left lobe, oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant jaggedness and structural irregularity at the distal tips of both lobes, characterized by irregular pixel voids and high-relief colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Ambient water spray creating a high-frequency circular particulate field (droplets) surrounding the fluke silhouette.
